text.title: Express slot reminder
text.idea: push reminder 15 minutes before the express slot the buyer booked
text.why: buyers forget slots; 22% of express orders are missed
text.context: evening, when buyers plan the next day; couriers already have the route
text.value: the order arrives on time without checking the app
text.restrictions: iOS push permission is needed; no SMS budget
text.affected: about 40 000 buyers a month who book express
text.behavior: buyers set phone alarms or call support to confirm the slot
text.capabilities: push system, slot data, courier ETA
text.tasks: turn reminders on or off; change the slot from the reminder
text.awareness: prompt at checkout; reminders list in the profile
text.support: wrong time zone, no push permission; FAQ and chat link
text.goals: cut missed express slots from 22% to 10%
text.success: missed slots under 10% for 4 weeks; 70% reminder open rate
text.activities: build push reminder, link slot data, test with 5% of buyers
